svg.text: GHOSTED: Gary the pigeon postman, body map v1 (Illustrator, 2026-11-26)
Decided before the sheet: proportions, landmarks, wing joints, attachment points (cap, brim, badge, bag, strap, envelope sockets), and a check at the game camera (26 m, pitch 42).
A. FRONT (upright, symmetric)
cap top H 209
head top H 198
cap band (front edge) H 188
eye line = ear points H 164
beak root H 148
chin / neck H 122
wing root (shoulder) H 106
belly (bag centre) H 52
knee H 30
sole H 0
B. SIDE (facing left) and BACK
1 head
C. WINGS: 2 rigid segments each (arm 70 u, hand 100 u + 3 finger feathers); hinges at the wing root and the wrist (red)
fold (rest), spread (flight: span 2 x (44 + 70 + 100) = 428 u), hold (his right wing reaches forward, the fingers hold the envelope in front of the chest)
fold (side)
spread (front)
hold (3/4)
envelope in the beak (3/4)
PROPORTIONS (head = cap top to chin = 87 u)
Standing 209 u = 2.40 heads, cap included.
Wingspan in flight 1.03 m = 1.06 x Kit.
Head: a ball, 76 u, centre H 160, 14 u forward.
Body: an egg 116 x 108 x 148 u, tilted 22 deg (chest
up, tail end down). Tail: a flat fan at the back, low.
LANDMARKS (blue)
Eyes on the eye line H 164, x 135 / 165: ink ovals + glint.
Ear points: the eye line at the head sides (x +-37),
under the feathers: the cap band clears them.
Beak root H 150 on the face front; the cone points
forward and 15 deg down. NO MOUTH: the beak is the
only thing below the eyes.
Neck: the head sits on the body, no visible neck line.
Wing roots (shoulders) H 106-108, at the body sides.
Feet: gold, under the belly front, H 0-32.
ATTACHMENT POINTS (magenta)
Cap: centred on the crown, set back and tilted back
14 deg; band bottom 10 u under the head top. Brim
at the front, ink. Badge: cream, cap front.
Bag: on his LEFT belly front, turned 24 deg out.
Strap: one loop over his RIGHT shoulder, across
the chest to the bag, round the back (real sash).
Envelope sockets: (1) the beak tip, the letter hangs
below it; (2) the right wing's finger feathers.
Swap parts, never both at once.
E. GAME CAMERA CHECK (x3; 1x at right). Gary next to Kit (real render); then the landmark dots (blue) and attachment points (magenta) at net yaw 5, pitch 42.
Eyes vs cap at 1x: the lowest cap or brim pixel is 2.6 px (left) / 2.9 px (right) ABOVE the eye top. Each eye is 2.4 px tall. Nothing covers the eyes.
Beak at 1x: 2.9 x 6.4 px, gold, a down-pointing wedge under the eyes: it reads as a beak, not a mouth.
Height 35 x 26 px standing (Kit 75 px). Flight, wings level: 81 px wide (Kit 75 px tall).
Read: navy cap with a light badge, two eyes, gold beak, a light blue-grey ball body, blue wings at the
sides, a brown satchel on the belly, gold feet.
